object_type.description: Kind of object the entry is about, such as `proxy-host`, `certificate` or `user`

object_id.description: Id of the object the entry is about; 0 when the event has no single object, such as a backup

npmpro_api_token_id.description: ID of the API token that made the change, null for a change made in a session or by NPMpro itself

npmpro_api_token_name.description: Name of that token when the entry was written, null when no token acted

meta.description: Details of the change: for a host its domain names, for a user its name and permissions; the content depends on the object type and action

user.description: The user who acted, only present with `expand=user`
